title: Dream Generation: Koi ka? Shigoto ka!?...
native_title: ドリーム・ジェネレーション ～恋か？ 仕事か！？…～
overview:
Dream Generation: Koi ka? Shigoto ka!?... is a raising simulation & love adventure game. The player controls 19-year-old Toranosuke Rokujō, an aimless college student who has no idea what he wants out of life. After meeting up with a group of his high-school classmates, he decides it's time to get his life in order, find a job, and find a girlfriend within the next year.

The simulation gameplay generally consists of deciding Toranosuke's schedule for each weekday: when and for how long to go to work, study, exercise, and rest. He will need to work to earn money for food and rent, study to improve his job prospects, and exercise to keep his health and energy up. During free time and on Saturdays and holidays, he can explore the town on foot to visit various locations, go shopping and meet the other characters. If he meets a girl and gets her phone number, he can ask her out on dates on Sundays; it's even possible to have dates with multiple girls on the same day, though it is also possible to get stood up, or to run into the second girl while out with the first.
